summary: Tested 4 new features (Page Audit, Debug Mode, Fuel Config UI, PDF Export) on top of Analytics Engine v1.0.0. Backend 12/12 pytest passing. Frontend all UI elements + integrations working.

issues: ResponsiveContainer width(-1)/height(-1) console warnings on mount - cosmetic only, carried over from iteration 4

passed_tests: Backend GET /api/audit/compare returns success, total_vehicles=12, mismatches count, navixy_raw vs engine_computed vs validation per vehicle, raw_navixy_calls logs, engine_audit block
Backend GET /api/export/pdf returns application/pdf, %PDF header, valid multi-KB payload
Backend PUT /api/config/fuel {default_consumption_rate:8.5} - subsequent fleet/stats has fuel_used_liters & fuel_cost_chf
Backend PUT /api/config/fuel {default_consumption_rate:null} - correctly clears rate (fix from iteration 4 works via exclude_unset=True)
Backend all 10 previous tests still pass (root, fleet/stats, trends, vehicle-comparison, efficiency, fuel default, idle-by-group, driver report)
Frontend debug-toggle button in header toggles debug overlays: 4 kpi-debug elements appear when ON, 0 when OFF, showing src/response time/cache/field
Frontend Costs tab: fuel-config-panel with fuel-price-input, fuel-rate-input, fuel-save-btn all working - saving 8.5 refreshes data and shows 683 CHF / 341.3 L on Carburant estime KPI
Frontend Audit tab hidden in normal mode

Frontend Audit tab visible with ?admin=true, shows audit-summary ('Toutes les donnees correspondent parfaitement'), audit-table with 12 audit-row-* entries, comparison columns Navixy vs Engine for mileage/odometer/engine_hours
Frontend Overview tab still renders all KPIs correctly (12 vehicules, 3 actifs, 4016 km)
action_items: Optional (cosmetic): give Recharts ResponsiveContainer parents explicit min height/width to silence -1 warnings
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to 714 lines with audit + PDF routes - consider extracting audit_router.py and pdf_export.py modules to keep server.py slim

audit/compare endpoint instantiates a fresh NavixyClient inline for raw calls - could be factored to a helper; also uses DEFAULT_NAVIXY_HASH directly instead of tenant hash `h`, which will be wrong for multi-tenant setups (line 506)
PDF export: imports reportlab inside the handler (cold-start OK, but move to top for clarity); client name lookup uses subdomain only, default 'LOGITRAK' hardcoded
test_credentials: None required. NAVIXY_HASH pre-configured. Admin mode via ?admin=true query param.
seed_data_creation: None - live Navixy API. Fuel config left with default_consumption_rate=null at test end (fixture cleans tenant_config).
context_for_next_testing_agent: 12 backend tests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py cover full engine + new features. audit/compare is slow (~30s), test uses 180s timeout. PUT /api/config/fuel with explicit null now correctly clears the field. Audit endpoint has a multi-tenant bug (uses DEFAULT_NAVIXY_HASH instead of tenant `h`) - not exercised in current default-tenant tests but flagged in code review.
